outcome: Give managing partner / delivery excellence head a governed method to improve unexplained progression disparities using candidate stage events, rubrics and fairness metrics, with final decisions…
overview: Recruitment Pipeline Bias Review addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in professional services operations. The first proof of value uses candidate stage events, rubrics and fairness metrics. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is unexplained progression disparities, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

benefits.text: Traceable prioritisation of candidate stage events
benefits.limits: Basis: design hypothesis. Depends on source quality and named decision owner

benefits.text: Measurable improvement in unexplained progression disparities
benefits.limits: Basis: customer-specific hypothesis. No uplift promised; validate in controlled pilot

benefits.text: Auditable approvals with the same evidence seen by the reviewer
benefits.limits: Basis: design property. Applies only to events routed through the new workflow

residency: Customer tenancy and in-country options to be assessed, not guaranteed

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: candidate stage events, rubrics and fairness metrics; define unexplained progression disparities and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Managing Partner / Delivery Excellence Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for unexplained progression disparities
